rejection_findings.root_cause: Semantic inflation where engaging UI surface was reported as full task completion despite 0-byte file and unfulfilled postconditions.
rejection_findings.remediation_mandate: Real application-mediated save must produce non-zero file with verified content hash; no partial engagement may ever be reported as PASS.

rejection_findings.root_cause: Rounding or reporting discrepancy that rounded 119/120 up to 100%, violating the zero-tolerance empirical rule.
rejection_findings.remediation_mandate: Exact rational counts required; 119/120 must be reported strictly as 99.2% and fail any 100% invariant.

rejection_findings.root_cause: Verdict self-promotion where PASS_CLEAN was emitted despite unresolved debris and process_cleaned_up=false.
rejection_findings.remediation_mandate: Contradiction gate enforced: process_cleaned_up=false or post_debris_detected=true forces verdict to FAIL with zero tolerance.

actual_evidence_state.nature_of_test: Static plan validation without physical UI interaction dispatch

rejection_findings.root_cause: Syntactic plan checks were substituted for end-to-end physical computer use execution.
rejection_findings.remediation_mandate: Physical laboratory must execute real Windows events, observe UI transitions, and verify physical disk/window artifacts.

actual_evidence_state.nature_of_test: Binary launch and exit code 0 without observable state transition verification

rejection_findings.root_cause: Process return code 0 was accepted as proof of desktop interaction completion.
rejection_findings.remediation_mandate: Return code alone is never proof of task success; affirmative postcondition verification on physical window/file state is mandatory.

governing_principles.oracle_inviolability: F0-24A.1 execution-truth oracle is authoritative and must not be weakened, bypassed, or special-cased.
governing_principles.telemetry_first: Every decision point must record WHAT WAS SEEN, WHAT WAS INFERRED, WHAT WAS DECIDED, and WHAT CHANGED.
governing_principles.laboratory_not_special_case: Notepad++ is the physical microscope for generic interaction, never a hardcoded production branch.
governing_principles.affirmative_cleanup: All task-owned application resources must be cleanly terminated upon task completion with zero orphaned processes or windows.
